title: Scooter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='22' y='66' width='50' height='10' rx='5' fill='#38d6ff'/>
  <rect x='22' y='66' width='50' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='10' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#6f7bd6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='3' fill='#9fb2ff'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='10' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#6f7bd6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='3' fill='#9fb2ff'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='66' y='34' width='6' height='36' rx='3' fill='#ff8ad1'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='58' y='30' width='24' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- handlebar grips -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='4' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='33' r='4' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- smiling face on deck front/fender area -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='61' rx='15' ry='9' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='59' r='2.4' fill='#2a2f5a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='59' r='2.4' fill='#2a2f5a'/>
  <circle cx='46.8' cy='58.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='58.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 63 Q52 69 59 63' fill='none' stroke='#2a2f5a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='63' r='2' fill='#ff9db0'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='63' r='2' fill='#ff9db0'/>
</svg>
